feedback.intrinsic: The team could take on too much at once and struggle to see which speech capability creates value.
feedback.instructional: Start narrow: choose one capability, connect it to value, prove it, and then expand.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. A focused pilot makes it easier to learn before building more.

flashcards.back: Latency is delay in speech processing.
Noise, microphone quality, speaker distance, and bandwidth affect accuracy.
To ensure speech meets accessibility standards.
Start with one high-value speech capability.
